# Residential Leave and License Agreement

1. Security Deposit Deduction: Licensor may retain the security deposit to restore the premises in its sole discretion, with a mandatory painting deduction.
2. Property Entry: Licensor and showing agents may enter the premises at any time without prior notice.
3. Joint and Several Liability: All licensees shall be jointly and severally liable for rent and repairs.
4. Termination Notice: Either party may terminate upon giving 30 days advance written notice.
